messages:
SRE Oncall: Alert: sudden spike in 502/gateway errors for hosted inference in eu-west2 started ~2026-03-17T16:14:28Z. Graph: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc/hosted-inference?orgId=1 (500->1200 502s/min)
Lina (Support): getting multiple customer tickets reporting auth timeouts and 502s when calling /v1/generate, repro steps attached.
Lina (Support): customer repro snippet: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` returns HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway and sometimes TLS handshake timeout.
Tim (Eng-Platform): seeing high TLS handshake timeouts in front-door logs, upstream returns 502s. Sample nginx upstream log: "upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream"
Raj (NetEng): running traceroute from an edge pop to the model-hosting pool, packet loss starts at hop 6 (transit provider). traceroute output:
```
traceroute to 10.4.12.5 (10.4.12.5), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  0.2 ms
 2  192.168.1.1  0.5 ms
 3  100.64.0.1  2.3 ms
 4  203.0.113.21  10.8 ms
 5  203.0.113.34  15.2 ms
 6  198.51.100.5  80 ms  200 ms  *
 7  198.51.100.9  110 ms  115 ms  108 ms
```
Raj (NetEng): hop 6 maps to our transit provider PE, looks like path oscillation / intermittent blackholing. I also see bursts of BGP UPDATE/withdraw at 16:12-16:16 UTC in our collector.
InfraBot: New provider ticket created #PROV-4521 (auto) and provider NOC notified.
Eva (Product): which customers impacted? Lina (Support): a handful of mid-tier EU customers using hosted inference, plus two Dedicated pools seeing elevated errors. Tickets linked in the incident jira.
Tim (Eng-Platform): quick mitigations suggested: 1) fail traffic to eu-west1 for affected prefixes by applying route policy, 2) temporarily increase client-side retry/backoff in our SDKs, 3) disable connection reuse for affected front-doors to force fresh TLS sessions.
Raj (NetEng): Can we announce more-specifics for the model-serving prefixes to steer away from the flaky transit path? I can prepare the route announcement but need ops approval and provider coordination.
SRE Oncall: Approve announcing more-specifics for 10m as a short-term mitigation. Coordinate timing and rollback plan.
Eva (Product): please include provider ticket ID in communications. Lina (Support): CSMs notified and we told customers we are investigating; promised ETA update in 30m.
Raj (NetEng): Provider NOC replied: they're seeing high-convergence on a PE due to maintenance, will rollback the change, expect stabilization in ~20-30m. We'll keep monitoring.
Tim (Eng-Platform): toggled fallback to cold model variant in the eu-west2 routing table to reduce long-lived upstream connections; QPS to affected pools down ~40% after change.
SRE Oncall: 502 spike trending down, 5xx rate decreasing. Keeping thread open until full stabilization and provider confirmation. Logging for postmortem captured.
Eva (Product): compile impacted customer list for post-incident outreach. Lina (Support): will assemble incident timeline + affected request ids and share with comms.
Raj (NetEng): I'll attach pcap snippets, BGP RIB snapshots and traceroutes to the incident ticket for RCA.
SRE Oncall: thanks all — marking monitoring watch for 1h. Will triage into postmortem if provider change confirmed as root cause. :thumbsup:
